svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.21.2.1 Chimney Flue Limitations
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.21 MASONRY AND CONCRETE CHIMNEYS AND FLUES
Chimney Flue Limitations

g.text: A flue serving a fireplace or
Solid-fuel flue: not connected to a
Solid-fuel flue and an oil appliance:
only if the solid-fuel appliance is
certified for it and both installations

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
A chimney flue that serves a fireplace or
incinerator does not serve any other
appliance.
A chimney flue that serves a
solid-fuel-burning appliance is not connected
to a natural-gas- or propane-fired appliance.
A chimney flue that serves a
solid-fuel-burning appliance is not connected
to an oil-burning appliance
unless the solid-fuel-burning appliance is
certified for such installation and the
installation of both appliances meets the
requirements of the relevant standards referenced
in Article 9.33.5.2.
Drawn: appliances as labelled blocks, connectors grey. Gold ? marks a connection allowed only on the conditions in Sentence (3).
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.21.2.1. (page 9-155)
